description: Client-side JavaScript for UI interactions including tab management, content toggling, sidebar collapse, Mermaid diagram fullscreen and zoom, homepage effects, and mobile theme toggle.

methods.name: showTab
methods.description: Activates a specific tab and its content based on tabId.

methods.name: applyFlags
methods.description: Sets page-specific classes based on URL path for SPA navigation.

methods.name: showTabs
methods.description: Displays a specific tab in the getting started page.

methods.name: typeOnce
methods.description: Animates typing effect for specified element.

methods.name: hasTOC
methods.description: Checks if the secondary sidebar contains content.

methods.name: setupSidebarToggle
methods.description: Configures toggle button for sidebars with local storage persistence.

methods.name: isDesktop
methods.description: Determines if current viewport matches desktop size.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Restores palette to header and resets toggle for mobile theme panel.

methods.name: openPanel
methods.description: Moves palette into mobile panel for small screens.
